title: My neighbor called my dachshund "ugly dog"
text:
12 years ago, my neighbor told me that he called my dachshund "ugly dog".  This was her then.  
His description cracked me up. https://t.co/QTkpNZywAM
blurb: Twelve years ago a neighbor nicknamed this dapple doxie "ugly dog," and their human still finds it hilarious. Judge for yourself: she's curled up on the couch looking spotty, silky and completely unbothered.
